##### Project general facts

Casa AHS by AHS Properties is an ultra-luxury residential landmark on the Dubai Water Canal, designed by Killa Design with interiors by HBA Residential. The building presents an exclusive collection of penthouses, sky villas, sky mansions and sky palaces, each conceived as a private home in the sky. Residences feature striking double-height ceilings, private infinity-edge pools, jacuzzis and expansive terraces with open views over the canal, Safa Park and the city skyline.

Shared amenities are designed around wellness and hospitality. The ground floor features an indoor pool with pool lounge, an outdoor pool, an onsen, a spa, steam and sauna rooms, a massage room, a Pilates and yoga studio, outdoor yoga and indoor and outdoor gyms. Residents also enjoy a cigar lounge, a residents' lounge, a screening room, a breakfast and café lounge and an omakase dining experience. A round-the-clock luxury concierge, a dedicated chauffeur service and a concierge app complete the offer.

Residences combine formal and casual living areas with formal dining, a show kitchen and a separate back-of-house kitchen, a teppanyaki station, a study and staff accommodation. Master suites include dressing rooms and en-suite bathrooms. Private elevators, personal parking, electric vehicle charging, bicycle storage and secured individual storage add everyday convenience. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens, ready for the owner's own furniture.

##### Location description and benefits

The Dubai Water Canal area connects Business Bay with the coast, creating a waterfront district of promenades, pedestrian bridges, hotels and upscale residences. Safa Park lies right next to the canal, offering landscaped lawns, walking paths and open green space in the heart of the city. The area combines a calm waterside atmosphere with immediate access to Dubai's most prestigious neighbourhoods.

Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road connect the district with Downtown Dubai, the Dubai International Financial Centre, Burj Al Arab and Mall of the Emirates, all within a short drive. Dubai International Airport is easily reached, while City Walk, Jumeirah and the beaches offer dining, shopping and leisure close to home.

The Dubai Water Canal is one of the city's most sought-after addresses for ultra-luxury living, with limited supply of large-format residences. Its central position between Downtown Dubai, Business Bay and Jumeirah supports strong demand from high-net-worth buyers and premium tenants. Freehold ownership and a scarcity of comparable waterfront homes underpin long-term value.
